grounds: Every choice this correction round made was settled by an explicit requirement in ORIGINAL_REQUEST.md, by the approved ANALYSIS/PLAN/DESIGN, or by REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION.md's two required actions. Iteration 1's disclosed live-path exception -- a settled result declaring nothing was treated as a non-participant -- was NOT a defensible departure and has been removed rather than re-disclosed: a missing decision record is the first item on ORIGINAL_REQUEST's fail-closed list and no disclosure authorizes departing from it. The requirement to fail closed at a B2/B3 boundary and the requirement not to weaken the existing lifecycle recovery guarantee were checked against each other and found NOT to conflict: a dispatch that delivered no result never reached B2 or B3, so scoping the rule to delivered results satisfies both without presuming CLEAR anywhere. No boundary element declared by this phase is triggering: the change is confined to scripts/ inside this repository (blast_radius: module), it is fully reversible by reverting this commit, and it touches no monetary, security, privacy, compliance or long-term-lock-in element. Therefore no decision item is open at this boundary.
scope: Covers the IMPLEMENTATION phase's own conduct at iteration 2: the resolution of REVIEW_IMPLEMENTATION.md findings F-001 and F-002, the replacement of the one test that encoded the removed exception, the six added observe_unexpected_exit refusal tests and the offline fixtures updated so the suite can express the property. The one remaining deviation from DESIGN's prose -- the live-path refusal is RAISED rather than returned -- stays disclosed in the artifact with its evidence and preserves every approved conclusion.
